text:
jon: Heads-up — PIONEER_AI flagged a billing spike: looks like ~425k embedding rows were counted in both March and April invoices due to a meter-window timezone mismatch during DST roll-forward. Need quick reconciliation and approval for corrective credit.

meera: interesting. do we have the windows and counts?

jon: quick summary: our metering export uses UTC midnights, but exporter-shadow used local timezone for a brief period during the DST cutover on 2026-03-29, which produced an overlapping 01:00..02:00 UTC segment that got exported twice.

meera: ran comparison (sanitized):
```sql
-- March invoice window (2026-03-01..2026-03-31 23:59 UTC) includes exporter segment A
select count(*) from embeds_metered where acct='PIONEER_AI' and ts between '2026-03-29 00:00' and '2026-03-29 01:00'; -- 2,125,312
-- April invoice window (2026-04-01..2026-04-30) includes exporter segment B that overlaps due to local offset
select count(*) from embeds_metered where acct='PIONEER_AI' and ts between '2026-03-29 00:30' and '2026-03-29 01:30'; -- 2,550,624
-- overlapping rows (intersect by event_hash): 425,312
```

ops_luke: ops confirm: exporter-shadow was temporarily set to server local tz (America/Chicago) during a deploy. that caused the 30m overlap. raw ingest shows unique event_ids but the exporter wrote the same events twice into two adjacent windows.

jon: customer noticed because they run daily reconciliations and saw the same event IDs appearing in two invoices. they're requesting the full duplicate credit.

meera: pricing math: duplicate_count = 425,312. embed unit = $0.0004. credit = 425,312 * 0.0004 = $170.1248 -> $170.12 after rounding.

legal_sf: contract check: retroactive credits for billing system errors are allowed; need clear memo language and audit CSV. Also flag for vendor SLA if applicable.

cfo_emma: two items: 1) confirm dedupe method used to identify duplicates (exact match on event_hash + model_signature + ts fuzz), 2) confirm whether any of the overlapping rows were legitimately retried by client (avoid double credit).

meera: dedupe: exact sha256(event_payload) match + model id + payload length. we validated a random sample: 100/100 matches exact. checked against client-provided samples; no client-side reingests detected in their logs. safe to credit. audit CSV exported to s3://redwood-recon/2148001111/pioneer_overlap_ids.csv (internal).

ops_luke: rollback plan: we'll write billing_override entries for those event_ids with reason "exporter-timezone-dup". overrides are idempotent and reversible within 10 minutes. backfill job ETA 20m after approval.

jon: customer request: full refund of duplicate amount. they prefer credit memo rather than invoice adjustment since March invoice already finalized.

cfo_emma: approve credit memo for $170.12. require memo note: "Credit: duplicate metering events due to exporter timezone misconfiguration during DST cutover on 2026-03-29." CC legal and attach CSV. Also require an internal postmortem and a change to the exporter deploy checklist to prevent tz flips.

billing.bot: Automated action queued: create credit memo draft CM-2026-0502-PIONEER-170.12, reason "exporter-timezone-dup", reference thread 2148001111.

meera: starting backfill now. will post CSV link and results when done.

billing.bot: Credit memo created: CM-2026-0502-DRAFT-PIONEER-170.12. Status: DRAFT.

ops_luke: backfill complete: overrides applied = 425,312 events. ledger delta staged and validated.

meera: attached CSV to credit memo: s3://redwood-recon/2148001111/pioneer_overlap_ids.csv.

billing.bot: Credit memo finalized: CM-2026-0502-PIONEER-170.12. Status: posted. Notification queued to billing contact: pioneer-billing@pioneer.example.

jon: customer notified and acknowledged; asked for PMs to present postmortem.

cfo_emma: good. please add INFRA & PRODUCT follow-up tickets to enforce UTC-only exporter config and add a DST cutover test to the deploy pipeline.

ops_luke: creating INFRA-8923 and PROD-2010 now.

meera: closing thread. will follow up once postmortem is published.
